hooks.command: for f in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/headroom" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/headroom.exe"; do [ -x "$f" ] && exit 0; done; echo "headroom: binary not installed; run /headroom:setup"
for f in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/headroom" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/headroom.exe"; do [ -x "$f" ] && exec "$f" pretool; done; exit 0
for f in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/headroom" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/headroom.exe"; do [ -x "$f" ] && exec "$f" prompt; done; exit 0
